text:
Anya: Quick status dump on Optimize toolkit delivery — wanted async visibility. Tracking three things: quant recommendations, batching/caching suggestions, and regression alert hooks. Where we at on owners/milestones?

Matt: Owning quant recommendations. Milestone: RFC landed, PRs for q-aware profiles in review. Targeting next Tues for merge. Blocker: need perf numbers from staging for 4-bit vs 8-bit on M60 pool.

Sara: I'll take batching/caching suggestions. PoC for dynamic prefix caching is done, PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/optimize/pulls/87 : please review. Main question is default TTL — currently 30s, might be too short for our chat workloads. :thinking_face:

Jen (devops): Heads up — staging M60 pool is at 95% tonight due to long-running eval jobs. Can't run large perf matrix until we free up nodes. I can spin up a burst pool but will cost delta. Ping me which jobs to prioritize.

Matt: @Jen thanks. Can we reserve 4 M60s for 4 hours Monday morning? CI matrix has 24 runs, but we can batch them. If cost hits >$X threshold, let me know.

Sara: For TTL I suggest 60s for chat use, 5s for short-completion inference. We should make it configurable per route. Proposed config snippet: ```{"route": "/chat/*", "cache_ttl_s": 60, "priority_buckets": ["short", "long"]}```

Anya: Regression alerts — I've wired a basic hook into the eval pipeline to post to #incidents when metric delta > 3% for top-5 prompts. It's behind a feature flag; need someone to add noisy false-positive filters.

ci-bot: Build #optimize/toolkit-87 succeeded (jobs: unit, lint, perf-smoke). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/4567 :eyes:

Matt: Assigning reviewers: @Sara, @Anya — PR 87 needs a quick look for cache semantics. Also creating INF-1234 to track quant perf numbers + staging reservation.

Sara: I can review later today, but schedule looks tight. If Matt can merge the quant PR first, I'll rebase.

Jen (devops): Reserved 4 M60s Mon 9-13 UTC. Please tag jobs with `optimize:priority` label. I'll cancel if cost balloons.

Anya: Cool. Owners summary: Matt -> quant recs (merge target Tue), Sara -> batching/caching (PR 87), Jen -> staging reservation/infra. Action items: Matt post perf matrix link, Sara update TTL config options, Jen watch cost and confirm reserved nodes Monday. I'll follow up Mon AM and flip the flag for regression alerts once false-positive filters added. :thumbsup:
